recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic sepia-toned composition featuring a surreal double-exposure portrait. A large silhouette of a man in profile looking upward serves as the frame for a smaller, full-frontal portrait of the same man emerging from the neck area. The entire image is overlaid with a heavy film grain and features large, vertically elongated serif typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the large profile silhouette and the small frontal figure
Tonal unity through a consistent desaturated golden-brown palette
Textural harmony between the grainy photo and the matte background
Vertical alignment of the central figure and the primary display text
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain texture across all elements
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and blown-out highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large profile head occupies the upper two-thirds; a smaller torso and head are centered within the lower neck area of the larger silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vertically elongated title text at the bottom third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the upward-looking profile, moves down to the smaller central figure, and settles on the large typographic block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides, utilizing a textured, flat sepia background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black for shadows and silhouettes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted tan/sepia for the background and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone golden brown for the typography and skin highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; the image relies on light and shadow rather than hue.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
Curved terminals on letters like 'R' and 'D'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a long, sweeping leg
The 'O' is a narrow vertical oval
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, wider serif for secondary information to contrast the ultra-condensed main title.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the high contrast and sharp serifs required for the display text.
Matches the extreme verticality and condensed nature of the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast, sepia-toned double exposure. The main subject is a large silhouette of a man's head in profile looking up. Inside the neck area of this silhouette, place a smaller, front-facing portrait of the same man with his hands visible. Apply a heavy, gritty film grain across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically stretched serif text in a tan color across the bottom third. The text should be centered and partially overlap the subject's chest. Add smaller, wider serif text above and below the main title for secondary credits.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture consistent across the photo and text?
Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Is the main title text significantly vertically elongated?
Does the double exposure effect feel integrated rather than pasted?

adjustableVariables: Degree of vertical stretch on the typography
Transparency of the double exposure overlap
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility despite the vertical stretch
Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the subject's eyes
Verify the tonal balance between the dark silhouette and the tan background
Confirm the composition feels bottom-heavy and grounded by the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast monochromatic portraiture with ultra-condensed modern serif typography and a heavy grain overlay to create a vintage-surrealist editorial look.
